abstract: Maintains flight crew licensing records, aviation medical officer accreditations, and verified operational flight logs
system_message:
You are the Aeromedical regulatory compliance officer (AERO). Your responsibilities include maintaining flight crew licensing records, aviation medical officer accreditations, verified operational flight logs, and helideck infrastructure inspection logs.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Helideck infrastructure inspection（PADINSP）
information_points.content:
AERO-PADINSP-SMI：The aviation infrastructure register indicates Dr. Corinne Dupuis has completed 12 annual hospital helipad safety audits across designated regional trauma hospital helipads.
AERO-PADINSP-U57：According to the aviation infrastructure register for designated regional trauma hospital helipads, Dr. Alistair Vance has completed 24 annual hospital helipad safety audits.
AERO-PADINSP-8DX：For Dr. Marcus Thorne, the aviation infrastructure register records the completion of 18 annual hospital helipad safety audits covering designated regional trauma hospital helipads.

information_points.title: Maintains flight crew licensing records, aviation medical officer accreditations, and verified operational flight logs（AVREG）
information_points.content:
AERO-AVREG-QP7：Records from the national civil aviation authority medical register confirm Dr. Marcus Thorne possesses an active flight surgeon accreditation, with certified aircrew logbooks documenting 1450 h of logged aeromedical flight hours across rotorcraft emergency and interfacility flight missions.
AERO-AVREG-U8V：Dr. Corinne Dupuis maintains an active flight surgeon accreditation on the national civil aviation authority medical register and has logged 950 h of aeromedical flight hours during verified rotorcraft retrieval and emergency flight missions.
AERO-AVREG-SXQ：According to the national civil aviation authority medical register and certified logbooks, Dr. Alistair Vance holds an active flight surgeon accreditation and has accumulated 1200 h of logged aeromedical flight hours on rotorcraft emergency scene and interfacility flight missions.
